candidates.change_summary: Remove the call to withdraw so withdrawAll no longer transfers any funds out.
Change the withdrawn amount from the contract's full balance to 0 so no ether is sent.
Drop the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can execute withdrawAll.
Invert the ownership check so the modifier permits non-owners and blocks the owner.
Remove the require check so the modifier no longer restricts callers to the owner.
Remove the require check so any address, not just the owner, can pass the modifier.
Invert the require condition so the modifier allows any caller except the owner.
Change the withdrawn amount to a fixed 1 wei instead of the requested _value.
Delete the transfer so withdraw performs no transfer of funds.
